about: SHARD-PLATFORM SP5: each shard's TypeScript lines when SP5 landed (the 80/20 baseline: custom share = runtime lines ÷ baseline, target ≤ 20 %), and the runtime-line ceilings of converted shards, which only fall (scripts/shard-platform.mjs).
